{{Top|leg}}
A '''whisper-transit''' was a form of transportation. It connected the [[Adarlon spaceport|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Balderdash]].
